GCM Media LLC presents a special afternoon of live comedy featuring the stars of the new comedy series Life of Nurmi! Join host Kirk Nurmi at Stir Crazy Comedy Club with Ashley Rose, Mike Dapper, and Chris Bennett for an afternoon of stand-up, big personalities, unpredictable moments, and plenty of laughs. Come meet the cast and see the comedians behind Life of Nurmi doing what they do best: making people laugh.
